meta.title: DeepSeek Memory Engine
meta.description: Personal rework — please do not compare it against SurfCore; contact the author for takedown. Replaces SurfCore's per-day clarity ladder with a score-lifetime engine (daily/long/forever tiers, points when mentioned, promotions never fall back, forgotten memories recallable). Note: it modifies SurfCore 0.8.8 files in the desktop profile; restart DSH after applying.
